caption: The drawing depicts a beige or light gray cylindrical ceramic jar with a slightly wider rim and two small side handles. The jar features a decorative, blue floral pattern in the center, consisting of a stem with three clusters of stylized flowers and leaves. Above the floral design, a blue oval label contains text that reads, “E. Smith & Sons Manufacturers 38 Peck Slip, N.Y.”, along with the number “3” below it. The jar is set against a plain, off-white background with a faint rectangular border, and the artist’s signature “Annie B. Johnston” appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
